continuationAnswer.constraints: Base is Muizenberg rather than Camps Bay. Six adults, beginner surfers who want legitimate supervised lessons—not unsupervised surfing. Accommodation must be a whole home with at least 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, genuine kitchen, reliable Wi-Fi for one work morning, and a maximum total of ZAR 36,000 including fees for the full stay. One relaxed golf round remains planned, preferably with a pre-booked private/group vehicle that can carry six adults and six golf bags. No bookings or publication have been made.
